notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
What's New:

[b]Refined Act I:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Narrative: We've reworked Act I to enhance story pacing, reduce exposition, and provide richer character development.
[*] Enhanced Character Dialogue: Dive deeper into the game with improved interactions and compelling dialogue that bring our characters to life.
[/list]

[b]New Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded Arsenal: Discover new weapons and armor sets! Equip your units with these to leverage our fully implemented combat triangle.
[*] Individual Stat Growths: Units now feature individual stat growths, allowing for boosted and lowered stats. This addition lets you customize each unit's utility and role on the battlefield, adding a layer of strategic depth to unit development.
[*] Monetary Rewards and Loot: Completing levels now rewards you with gold. Keep your eyes peeled for lootable items during your quests.
[*] Updated Shop: Our shop will refresh its inventory after each level, providing new gear and items to assist in your adventures.
[/list]

[b]Enhancements and Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] UI and Control Improvements: We've made several adjustments to the user interface and controls to improve your gameplay experience.
[*] Bug Fixes: Numerous under-the-hood fixes have been applied to enhance game stability and performance.
[/list]

notes.title: April Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]April Update #1[/h1]
We're thrilled to announce our latest game update, now available on Steam!
This update enhances gameplay depth, strategic elements, and visual appeal. We've introduced a number of progressions systems allowing for greater customization and strategy through the addition of equippable items, damage and attack speed stats for all items, and unit base stat growths. 

Gameplay has been enriched with updated leveling mechanics, the removal of fog of war for enhanced strategic decision-making, and balanced unit spawn limits. Visual upgrades include spine models with unique character sprites.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback, helping us shape the game's evolution in Early Access. We have more coming this month, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40740092/becefcce033ddbed32c8d1531ee3e78373fb452b.png[/img]

[h2]Inventory and Equipment:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a comprehensive unit equipment and inventory system.
[*] Added functionality for equipping and unequipping items.
[*] Added damage and attack speed stats for all items.
[*] Updated unit base stat growths, refining character progression and customization.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enhanced player progression with updated leveling mechanics, providing a more rewarding experience.
[*] Removed fog of war to increase strategic visibility and decision-making.
[*] Established level unit spawn limits for units, ensuring balanced gameplay.
[*] Introduced refactored spine models and unique character sprites for character identification.
[*] Fixed an issue with selecting units by clicking, streamlining unit management.
[*] Implemented linked unit selection and spawn mechanics for strategic deployment.
[*] Added Ctrl-click and Shift-click functionality for improved unit selection and control.
[/list]

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved map level-select tokens for better clarity and aesthetics.
[*] Added an Early Access dialog card, enhancing communication with players about game development status.
[*] Linked profile data to selected units, personalizing player experiences.
[*] Populated the character profile screen, providing detailed information about characters’ equipment, stats, and abilities.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where an alpha layer was incorrectly displayed on the threshold screen.
[*] Fixed crashes related to attempting to save and deleting save files.
[*] Addressed a bug where corpses retained traits of the unit, affecting gameplay balance.
[*] Eliminated unintended sound effects when interacting with invisible buttons.
[*] Corrected audio issues within tutorials to improve player experience.
[/list]

See you next update!
